articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Premier League clubs line up for Como defender
articles.description: Como center back Jacobo Ramón has caught the eye of Manchester United, Chelsea, Arsenal and Liverpool. Transfer Talk has the latest.

articles.headline: 'I'm not Mohamed Salah' - Bradley Barcola doesn't feel Liverpool pressure
articles.description: Liverpool forward Bradley Barcola has insisted that he isn't feeling any pressure following his big-money move from Paris Saint-Germain and won't dwell on the impact of predecessor Mohamed Salah.

articles.headline: Dirk Kuyt hails 'another miracle in Istanbul' after Fenerbahce beat former club Liverpool
articles.description: Fenerbahce interim head coach Dirk Kuyt hailed "another miracle in Istanbul" after his side twice came from behind to beat Liverpool 3-2 in the Champions League on Wednesday night.

articles.headline: Moreno: Liverpool constantly prone to mistakes
articles.description: Moreno: Liverpool constantly prone to mistakes

articles.headline: Liverpool bemoan 'cheap, messy goals' in loss at Fenerbahce
articles.description: Liverpool head coach Andoni Iraola bemoaned his side's poor defending of set pieces leading to "cheap, messy" goals which cost them a 3-2 defeat at Fenerbahce.

articles.headline: Champions League recap: Fenerbahçe stun Liverpool, Como's 9-1 win makes history
articles.description: Fenerbahçe earned a shock 3-2 win against Liverpool, while Como made history on a Tuesday full of UEFA Champions League action.

articles.headline: Fenerbahce 3-2 Liverpool: Turkish side come from behind to claim famous win - as it happened
articles.description: Fenerbahce twice came from behind to claim a famous win over Liverpool on Wednesday night.

articles.headline: Greenwood leads Fenerbahce rally to end Liverpool's perfect UCL start
articles.description: Even Liverpool 's multi-million pound bench could not rescue a team floundering in Istanbul as a chaotic performance was punished by Fenerbahce as they twice came from behind to win 3-2.

articles.headline: Man United fans throwing tennis balls is part of soccer's rich history of supporter protests
articles.description: After Manchester United's match was disrupted by tennis balls thrown onto the pitch, here are some of the various ways fans have made themselves heard.

articles.headline: Fenerbahce coach Dirk Kuyt ready for 'very special' reunion with Liverpool
articles.description: Former Liverpool forward Dirk Kuyt will park his feelings for his old club as he has a job to do for Fenerbahce.

articles.headline: Andoni Iraola: Liverpool have to handle Fenerbahce atmosphere
articles.description: Liverpool head coach Andoni Iraola wants to "kill the confidence" Fenerbahce get from a raucous home crowd and believes improving his side's attacking output is one of the best ways.

articles.headline: Liverpool's $500m forward line is failing. Can they turn it around?
articles.description: Liverpool's star-studded, expensively assembled attack has scored fewer Premier League goals this season than Ipswich. That needs to improve immediately.

articles.headline: Ryan Gravenberch out of Liverpool's clash with Fenerbahce with heel injury
articles.description: Injury has ruled Liverpool midfielder Ryan Gravenberch out of the Champions League match against Fenerbahce in Istanbul.

articles.headline: Noni Madueke: Alexis Mac Allister tried to 'bait me' into red card
articles.description: Noni Madueke has said that Alexis Mac Allister tried to "bait" him into getting a red card during Arsenal's 1-0 win over Liverpool at Anfield.

articles.headline: Arsenal got a big win at Liverpool, but why no Isak penalty?
articles.description: Arsenal got a big win at Liverpool to go clear atop the Premier League, but Liverpool should have had a penalty. Plus: Michael Carrick's Man United future, Milan's bounce-back, Bayern's frustrations and more.

articles.headline: Dominik Szoboszlai asks if Liverpool expected to 'dive' to win penalty
articles.description: Dominik Szoboszlai has questioned whether officials want players to "dive" in the box after Liverpool were denied a penalty against Arsenal.

articles.headline: Piero Hincapié aims dig at Virgil van Dijk after Arsenal beat Liverpool
articles.description: Piero Hincapié aimed a pointed taunt at Virgil van Dijk after Arsenal beat Liverpool on Sunday.

articles.headline: Alexis Mac Allister 'embarrassing' for Noni Madueke clash - Jamie Carragher
articles.description: Alexis Mac Allister has been criticised by Jamie Carragher for his role in a clash with Noni Madueke in Arsenal's 1-0 win against Liverpool on Sunday.

articles.headline: Havertz's close-range finish puts Arsenal on top
articles.description: Kai Havertz pokes home in the 16th minute to deliver the Gunners the decisive goal against Liverpool at Anfield.

articles.headline: Andoni Iraola: I will 'definitely' tell Alexander Isak to go down in future after Arsenal penalty controversy
articles.description: Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola has said he will "definitely" tell Alexander Isak to go down if he is fouled inside the box in future after his team were denied a "clear penalty" against Arsenal.
